notes.title: Update v1.1.0.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]A complete wipe was necessary for this update, therefore your saves and options should be gone.

[h1][b]CLASSES AND SKILLS[/b][/h1]
[*]Classes and Skills rework is done.

Old classes are gone and there are now 10 classes to play with: Fire Mage, Ice Mage, Blood Witch, Necromancer, Cleric, Paladin, Amazon, Ranger, Berserker and Juggernaut.

Basic and Advanced skills are gone and skills are no longer randomly assigned but they are set according to the character class.

Each class has got a Primary Skill, a Secondary Skill, a DOT Skill and a Utility SKill.
Primary Skills cost no mana and they deal less damage.
Secondary Skills cost mana and they deal more damage.
DOT Skills are damage over time abilities, they cost mana and they have a short cooldown (about 2 seconds).
Utility Skills can be offensive abilities, crowd controls abilities, buffs and summons, they cost mana and they have a longer cooldown (8 seconds).

Here is a list of the new abilities.

FIRE MAGE
Fireball: launch a fireball that explodes on impact, damaging all enemies in the area.
Meteor: summon a meteor that explodes on impact, damaging all enemies in the area.
Firewall: summon a wall of fire that burns all enemies in the area.
Summon Drake: summon a Fire Drake Whelp that fights along your side (max 3).

ICE MAGE
Ice Shard: launch a shard of ice that shatters on impact, damaging all enemies in the area.
Cold Orb: hurl a pulsating orb of cold energy that travels through enemies, damaging everything in its path.
Ice Storm: summon a storm of shards of ice that shreds all enemies in the area.
Ice Spikes: summon spikes of ice that impale all enemies in the area.

BLOOD WITCH
Blood Missiles: launch orbs of cursed blood that explode on impact, damaging all enemies in the area.
Blood Well: summon a pool of cursed blood that explodes like a geyser, damaging all enemies in the area.
Raining Blood: summon a cascade of cursed blood, damaging all enemies in the area.
Blood Vortex: conjure a vortex that draws all nearby enemies to it and explodes, damaging all enemies in the area.

NECROMANCER
Dark Torrent: gather unholy energy to launch a barrage of unholy projectiles towards a target location.
Spectral Vanguard: summons a spectral vanguard that charges towards a target location, damaging all enemies in its path.
Soul Reaper: conjure a spectral scythe that reap the souls of all enemies hit and summons a wraith to fight along your side.
Summon Undead: summon an Undead Minion to fight along your side (max 5).

CLERIC
Orb Of Light: hurl a orb of light that explodes on impact and splits into other orbs that seek nearby enemies.
Soulshot: conjure a orb of pure energy that spins around you, damaging all enemies hit.
Volley Of Light: call down a barrage of missiles that bombards a target location, damaging all enemies in the area.
Smite: inscribe a holy mark at a target location that blasts all the enemis in the area and grants you a temporary bonus to your defence and attack speed for each enemy hit. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

PALADIN
Rapid Strikes: hit all enemies in range with a sequence of three rapid strikes.
Zeal: charge your hammer with energy and smash the ground unleashing explosions all around you.
Judgement: summon a pillar of lightning from the sky that strikes all enemies around you.
Shield Bash: slam all enemies in range with your shield.

AMAZON
Piercing Arrows: fire a barrage of magically imbued arrows that pierces through enemies.
Multishot: fire a fan of arrows, damaging all enemies hit.
Rain Of Arrows: fire a volley of magically imbued arrows at a target location, damaging all enemies in the area.
Scattershot: fire a powerful volley of arrows that knockbacks all enemies hit.

RANGER
Poison Barrage: fire a barrage of poisoned arrows.
Bombardment: fire a volley of poisoned arrows that explodes, damaging all enemies in the area.
Poison Cloud: fire a poisoned missile at a target location that explodes, dealing damage over time to all enemies in the area.
Summon Warg: summon a Warg to fight along your side (max 3).

BERSERKER
Frenzy: strike all enemies in range with two rapid hits and grants you a temporary bonus to your attack and movement speed. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
Whirlwind: spin your axes around you, striking everything in your path.
Cleave: slash all enemies in range with a massive swing, casusing them to bleed.
Stomp: smash the ground, damaging all nearby enemies and pulling them to you.

JUGGERNAUT
Sweep: swing your hammer twice, damaging all enemies in range.
Ground Slam: slam the ground and cause wave of volcanic eruptions, damaging all enemies in the area.
Seismic Waves: smash the ground causing seismic waves and crumbling rocks all around you, damaging all enemies in the area.
Cyclone: spin your hammer around you, striking all enemies in range.

[*]When you create a guild, the Applications List have now 5 different classes to choose from; previously it could contains dupes.

[*]Health Points and Mana Points are no longer fixed but they change according to the class you're currently playing with; casters have less life and more mana, melee classes have more health and less mana and Amazons, Rangers and Cleric are half way between the others.

[*]The Action Bar has been redone and now it shows all your abilities; each one of them has a specific icon and if you mouse over it a tooltip will pop out, showing the description of the ability, the damage type and the crowd control effect.

[*]Frenzy's attack speed buff has been changed, from 5% to 10%.

[*]Each skill has a new invisible modifier to help balance the health and mana leech according to the skill speed, the number of hits, etc.

notes.title: Update v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]CHINESE LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1]
Simplified and Traditional Chinese are now available.

When you start the game for the first time, the client will select a language between English, Simpiflied Chinese or Traditional Chinese according to the language you're currently using in Steam.

If you prefer to use a different language, you can change it inside the Options Panel and the settings will be saved for the future.


[h1][b]TOKEN SYSTEM[/b][/h1]
A new currency, called Enemy Tokens, has been added to the game; you can collect them by killing Bandits around the world and exchange them for items at the Encampment by talking to a new NPC called Lieutenant Feng.

When dropped, Enemy Tokens look like a big copper coin and you can check the amount you have at the bottom of your inventory, next to your gold.

At the moment, only Bandits can drop the new currency, although more enemies will be avalaible as the world will be filled with new areas.


[h1][b]BANDIT CAMPS[/b][/h1]
Bandit Camps will now spawn randomly accross the world, filled with..well..Bandits.
It's the first step to make the world less empty and fill it with special areas and new enemies.
There are currently 5 different variations, 1 Fort and 4 Camps, and more will come soon.

As a result, there are now 3 new enemies: a Bowmna, a Crusher and a Wizard.

Each camp you encounter will contains an Elite Group, some Minions and if you're lucky a Treasure Chest too.


[h1][b]ITEM GENERATION[/b][/h1]
Fixed a bug that allowed the generation of items with a level superior to the max level.


[h1][b]DAMAGE AND DEFENSE[/b][/h1]
Fixed a bug the granted more armor and magic resistance than intended.
As a result the damage of all enemies has been reviewed and it's still under supervision; it's a long and difficult process, so please be patience and if you think that  something is unbalanced please leave a feedback in the relative section!


[h1][b]PETS[/b][/h1]
As a consequence of the above, pets stats has been reviewed; now pets have slightly more defense, damage reduction (which scales according to the difficulty setting), health and health regeneration.

Health power ups have been changed; now when you're are healed by one of them, your pet will benefit from it too and it will be healed according to its health plus the bonus of the Upgrade "Like Candies".

Previously smaller pets had single target attack skills, while bigger ones had AOE attacks; to make all the pets equally appealing, all of them have now only AOE attacks.
This should also help them to heal better but keep in mind that pets aren't supposed to be immortal and tank everything for you, you need to call them to avoid dangerous situations and if you want to improve them you might want to invest some points in the relative Upgrades.


[h1][b]MUSIC[/b][/h1]
Added a second track for the Encampment.

Added a couple of Ambient Tracks; more tracks and improvements wil come come along with the release of new biomes.

It's the first step to make the world less empty and fill it with special areas and new enemies.
There are currently 5 different variations, 1 Fort and 4 Camps, and more will come soon.

As a result, there are now 3 new enemies: a Bowmna, a Crusher and a Wizard.

Each camp you encounter will contains an Elite Group, some Minions and if you're lucky a Treasure Chest too.


[h1][b]ITEM GENERATION[/b][/h1]
Fixed a bug that allowed the generation of items with a level superior to the max level.


[h1][b]DAMAGE AND DEFENSE[/b][/h1]

Previously smaller pets had single target attack skills, while bigger ones had AOE attacks; to make all the pets equally appealing, all of them have now only AOE attacks.
This should also help them to heal better but keep in mind that pets aren't supposed to be immortal and tank everything for you, you need to call them to avoid dangerous situations and if you want to improve them you might want to invest some points in the relative Upgrades.


[h1][b]MUSIC[/b][/h1]
Added a second track for the Encampment.

Added a couple of Ambient Tracks; more tracks and improvements wil come come along with the release of new biomes.

notes.title: The Last Sigil - Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
this announcement contains updates about the early access release date, the store page and the changes I've done to the game since Greenlight.


[h1][b]EARLY ACCESS[/b][/h1]
Early access is expected to start [b]Thor's Day 22 March 2018[/b]! Hopefully there will be no delay and in case something happens, I will post an update about it.


[h1][b]STORE PAGE[/b][/h1]
The store page is finally up! You can add the game to your wishlist and use the "General Discussions" section to ask any question you want; I will try to answer to you as soon as possible but please keep in mind that I'm the only person working on this game, so my time is limited.


[h1][b]STATE OF THE GAME[/b][/h1]
The title is vastly improved compared to the greenlight trailer version and  here's a quick summary.

[h1][b]NEW STATS[/b][/h1]
Characters base attributes have been changed, they now have 4 innate attributes,  strength, endurance, constitution and luck, and their values vary from 1 to 10. 
The first three influence your guild's power, energy and vitality, while the latter gives you a small chance to double your loot.

[h1][b]MYTHIC ITEMS[/b][/h1]
The artifact has been removed and I added a new layer of items called Mythic; these items will be more powerful than the epic ones and in addition they will come with a special effect, such as a chance to deal a deadly hit or apply a bleeding, or a chance to inscribe a rune which grants bonuses while standing on hit, or a chance to curse enemies, or passive bonuses like elemental damage, immunity to CC, etc.
There are currently 47 mythic effects, some can appear on every piece of equipment, others only on specific items; in the future more will come, so feel free to post any idea you will have about them.

[h1][b]EQUIPMENT CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/h1]
Enchanting and customization have been greatly improved; you can now drop scrolls of enchantments, scrolls of rebirth, scrolls of transmutation, blacksmith hammers and jeweller chisels.

Scrolls of Enchantments come in three types, lesser, normal and greater and they increase the attributes and bonuses of an item.
[list]
[*]Scrolls of Rebirth generate a new item of the same rarity of the one you used them on.
[*]Scrolls of Transmutation upgrade a normal item to a random rarity (magic, rare, epic, mythic).
[*]Blacksmith Hammers increase the damage or the defense of an item by 1% for each use, up to 10%.
[*]Jeweller Chisels add sockets to items in which you can put jewels, you can craft the latters at the forge if you have the necessary materials.
[/list]

As mentioned there are now 10 Jewels which you can craft at the forge, they have fixed bonus types, random bonus values, three rarity (magic, rare and epic) and you can put them inside the sockets of your equipment (1 item = 1 socket = 1 jewel). You can also remove them by using a Jeweller Chisel.

[h1][b]BANNERS[/b][/h1]
The Banners are equippable items you can find in containers, treasure chests and as loot by killing enemies. They have attributes bonuses, they come in four rarity (magic, rare, epic, mythic) and they give you an ability to summon them as long as you have one equipped; using the ability will summon the banner which will grants you and/or your minions temporary buffs, like increased damage or immunity to damage. When you use the skill, a cooldown will start and you won't be able to summon the banner again until the cooldown it's finished.

[h1][b]PETS[/b][/h1]
You can now find pets! There are currently 10 types in different colors and more will come. A few of them are available from a merchant in the town-hub, the rest are drop by enemies.
Like other items they have a level and they come with different rarities (magic, rare, epic, mythic); not all pets are the same, some are more tough, others deal more damage, some are melee, others are ranged.
When you equip a pet, it will spawn next to you, follow you around and attack every enemy on sight. To control your pet, there is a "call/unleash pet" ability which lets you call it back to you and set it to passive mode, or unleash it, setting the pet in aggressive mode.
Finally each pet has a special attack which will be available to you as an activable skill as soon as you equip a pet. These special attacks are powerful AOE which also apply a crowd control effect to all the enemies hit and like the banners, they come with a cooldown.

[h1][b]STATS DISTRIBUTOR[/b][/h1]
You can now assign/remove 10 attributes points per click by holding shift while clicking the relatives buttons; this makes the points distribution easier and faster. 

[h1][b]GUILD UPGRADES[/b][/h1]
The number of upgrades has been increased to 31 and they now influence many areas of the game, like offence, defence, resource management, magic find, curses, banners, pets and minons.
Before, if you wanted to change your build, you had to reset the points and reassign all of them; now there are two buttons which let you increase and decrease the points assigned to each upgrade, making everything easier and quicker.

[h1][b]CRAFTING PANEL[/b][/h1]
The panel has been updated.
[list]
[*]You can now craft 10 different jewels.
[*]Recipes missing materials are now colored in red.
[*]When you select an equipment recipe, you can read the number of attributes and bonuses the item will have.
[*]When you select a jewel recipe, you can read the types and the numbers of bonuses the item will have.
[/list]

[h1][b]HUD[/b][/h1]
The HUD has been updated.
[list]
[*]The skill bar contains new slots to accomodate the banner and pet abilities, in addition the pet icon will turn red when the pet dies.
[*]A buff bar has been added above the health bar.
[*]You can now show/hide player/pet/minions/enemies health mini-bar.
[*]You can now show/hide player/pet/minions/enemies damage numbers.
[*]A world map has been added to show the exterior areas and the presence of waypoints/portals.
[*]A zone mini-map has been added with the classic fog of war.
[/list]

[h1][b]AUTO-LOOT[/b][/h1]
You can now loot the nearby items by pressing the auto-loot button; if you have enough space in your inventory, the items will be automatically transferred into your bag. You can also customize which items you want to loot in the Options Panel, for example if you uncheck the "Magic" category, all the magic items will be ignored and remain on the floor.

[h1][b]EXTERIORS[/b][/h1]
The Encampment or Town-Hub is now surrounded by procedurally generated exteriors, which you have to explore in order to find the entrances to the dungeons/Sigils. The areas are connected via exits and some of them contain waypoints too, which you can unlock by clicking on them.

At the entrance of the first level of each dungeon but the last one, there is a waypoint too, and once unlocked, you can teleport from any other waypoint directly there.
Waypoints are linked to the difficulty you play at, so if you switch difficulty, the waypoints will be updated accordingly.

The teleport system is still in place and if you are out of combat, you can travel from anywhere in the world to the Encampment/Town-Hub and back whenever you want.

[h1][b]ELITE MODS[/b][/h1]
Elite enemies have now a specific damage resistance, a trait and an elite mod; the latter is a special AOE ability which may apply a crowd control effect too and is highly recommended to avoid any contact with them.

[h1][b]CROWD CONTROL EFFECTS[/b][/h1]
There are now 4 types of CCs, stun, slow, chill and freeze.
As the player, you can apply them automatically by using certain skills, or by equipping a weapon with a CC as a Mythic Effect; if instead you want to use a specific CC at a specific moment, you can use a pet ability.
Finally, as mentioned, elite enemies can apply CCs too, so watch out for them!


It should be all for this time, thanks!
